title: What's New In SuperSurf: Hints You Can Paste, Agents That Stay Apart
summary: The "Did you mean?" hint now suggests selectors that click what they describe. Two agents on one browser no longer share tabs, logs or dialogs. And there is a new opt-in mode where one server serves many agents. 42 changes, and `connect(client_id)` works as in 4.0.

title: What's New In SuperSurf: Playbooks Are JavaScript
summary: Playbooks are officially JavaScript — one script, any inputs, and failures that tell you what actually went wrong. Plus a brand new one-command installer that proves your browser is connected before it says it worked. 53 changes, four of them breaking.
